program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((div-col (find-first (lambda (c) (for/and ([r (range 0 h)]) (= (at g r c) 5))) (range 0 w))))
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid h w 0)]) ([p (find-color g 1)])
      (let ((nr (first p)) (nc (- (* 2 div-col) (second p))))
        (if (in-bounds? nr nc h w) (set-cell out nr nc 8) out)))))
